mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(o.gmv,0) gmv, IFNULL(o.payOrderCount,0) payOrderCount, IFNULL(o.payBuyerCount,0) payBuyerCount, IFNULL(r.afterSalesOrderCount,0) afterSalesOrderCount, IFNULL(r.refundAmount,0) refundAmount, CASE WHEN o.payBuyerCount > 0 THEN o.gmv / o.payBuyerCount ELSE 0 END AS averageTicketSize FROM ( SELECT SUM(payment_price) AS gmv, COUNT(id) AS payOrderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS payBuyerCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS afterSalesOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN arrival_status = '2' THEN refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS refundAmount FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) r ON 1=1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, #{format}) AS timePoint, IFNULL(SUM(payment_price), 0) AS gmv, COUNT(id) AS payOrderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS payBuyerCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY timePoint ORDER BY timePoint

SELECT oi.spu_name AS spuName, oi.pic_url AS picUrl, IFNULL(SUM(oi.payment_price), 0) AS salesAmount, IFNULL(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount, CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(oi.payment_price), 0) > 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / SUM(oi.payment_price) ELSE 0 END AS refundRate FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN order_info o ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN order_refund r ON oi.id = r.order_item_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.arrival_status = '2' WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.pay_status = '1' AND o.payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY oi.spu_id, oi.spu_name, oi.pic_url ORDER BY refundRate DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(id) >= 2 ) t

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(payment_price), 0) FROM order_info t1 WHERE t1.del_flag = '0' AND t1.pay_status = '1' AND t1.payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_info t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t1.user_id AND t2.pay_status = '1' AND t2.del_flag = '0' AND t2.payment_time < #{dto.startTime} )

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}) AS afterSalesCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND arrival_status = '2' AND update_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS refundCompletedCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '2' AND payment_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS unshippedTimeoutCount

SELECT oi.spu_name AS spuName, oi.pic_url AS picUrl, IFNULL(SUM(oi.buy_quantity), 0) AS salesCount, IFNULL(SUM(oi.payment_price), 0) AS salesAmount FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN order_info o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.pay_status = '1' AND o.payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY oi.spu_id, oi.spu_name, oi.pic_url ORDER BY salesCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '1' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS waitingForPaymentCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '2' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS waitingForDeliveryCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '3' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS shippedCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '4' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS completedCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '1' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS afterSalesCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND arrival_status = '2' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}) AS refundedCount

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN orderCount = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oneTimeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN orderCount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS twoToThreeTimesCount, SUM(CASE WHEN orderCount BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fourToFiveTimesCount, SUM(CASE WHEN orderCount >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixPlusTimesCount FROM ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(id) AS orderCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY user_id ) t

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN totalAmount BETWEEN 0 AND 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount0To100Count, SUM(CASE WHEN totalAmount > 100 AND totalAmount <= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount100To500Count, SUM(CASE WHEN totalAmount > 500 AND totalAmount <= 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount500To2000Count, SUM(CASE WHEN totalAmount > 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount2000PlusCount FROM ( SELECT user_id, SUM(payment_price) AS totalAmount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY user_id ) t

SELECT oi.category_name AS categoryName, IFNULL(SUM(oi.buy_quantity), 0) AS salesCount, IFNULL(SUM(oi.payment_price), 0) AS salesAmount FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN order_info o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.pay_status = '1' AND o.payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY oi.category_id, oi.category_name ORDER BY salesCount DESC LIMIT 10
